title: Amara and the Starlight Market
description: A girl is given one jar of starlight and has to decide what it is really for.
setting: A night market under the stars

pages.text: Once a year, on the night the stars come down low, the market opens behind the last house on Amara’s street.
The stalls sold ordinary things — spoons, fish, buttons — and one stall sold light. In jars. Very neatly.
The old seller looked at Amara for a long moment and said, “One jar. Not two. Choose what you need, not what you want.”
Amara wanted to keep it. She thought of her shelf, and how beautiful the jar would look on it, glowing, all hers.
Then she heard her neighbour’s baby crying in the dark, because their lamp had gone out. So she gave them the jar instead.
The seller saw. And so Amara got her jar after all, filled twice as full. What would you have done with yours?
